name: Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Incentive to Beneficiaries
benefit:
1. ₹**20,000**/- to beneficiaries who complete house construction within **4** months from the date of receipt of the first instalment.   1. ₹**10,000**/- to beneficiaries who complete house construction within **6** months from the date of receipt of the first instalment.
> **Disbursement of Funds**

1. Incentive amounts are credited to the beneficiary’s account from the State Nodal Account th
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the state of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be a beneficiary of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana (Gramin), PM-JANMAN, or any other Government-funded rural housing scheme. 1. The applicant household must be residing in rural Odisha and must be houseless or living in a kutcha house.
